# opalstack_cert (Data Source)

Looks up a TLS certificate by `id` or by `name`. The private key the API holds is never read. The name of a certificate does not have to be unique: look it up by `id` when more than one has it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opalstack_cert" "wildcard" {
  name = "wildcard-example-com"
}

output "wildcard_expires" {
  value = data.opalstack_cert.wildcard.exp_date
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) UUID of the certificate.
- `name` (String) Name of the certificate.

### Read-Only

- `cert` (String) The certificate, PEM encoded.
- `exp_date` (String) When the certificate expires, as the API reports it.
- `intermediates` (String) The intermediate certificates, PEM encoded, if the certificate has any.
- `sha256_fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate.
